headings.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight

typography.rules: DO NOT use Inter or Space Grotesk for headings. Headings must always use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.

grid_modes.mode_a_hero_and_pillars: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8
grid_modes.mode_b_dashboard_and_games: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6

spacing_and_layout.padding_rules: Generous spacing philosophy: use p-6, p-8, or p-12 for content cards with 1px border. Never touch text edges to card borders.
spacing_and_layout.direct_child_rule: CRITICAL: All motion.div or animated cards inside CSS grid MUST be direct children or styled with layout wrappers correctly.

navigation.header_style: sticky top-0 z-50 w-full bg-[#090D16]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-800/80 px-4 lg:px-8 py-3.5

ahara: Food Database with Search & Category Filters
jala: Water Quality Parameter Explorer (pH, TDS, Hardness, Micro-plastics)
swara: 7-Note Solfeggio / Swara Selector (Sa, Re, Ga, Ma, Pa, Dha, Ni)
Web Audio API Synthesizer / Audio Player
manas: Interactive 3D Brain model using React Three Fiber / Canvas
Clickable Brain Regions (Prefrontal Cortex, Amygdala, Hippocampus, Occipital)
interactive_components.ai_assistant: Floating Widget 'Deha Veda AI Assistant' available site-wide with prompt suggestions
interactive_components.membership: Free vs 1-Month Premium toggle, Live Subscriber Counter, QR Code Scan-to-Subscribe modal/drawer
interactive_components.admin: Admin Dashboard with charts (Recharts/Shadcn) showing member breakdown, pillar engagement, game stats

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, cards, modals, nav links) MUST have data-testid in kebab-case format.
testing_and_accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Full focus states with focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-400 focus:outline-none.
testing_and_accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion in Framer Motion / CSS transitions.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 5 pillars (Ahara, Jala, Swara, Manas, Games) with full interactive tools.
Ensure the floating AI Chatbot widget operates across all routes.
Include data-testid on every interactive button, link, tab, input, and card element.
Use proper background colors for navbar (no fully transparent header over text).
Verify mobile responsive layouts, stacking pillar cards on small screens.
Make sure 3D Brain component in Manas works smoothly with fallback for non-Web GL devices.
